long_biography.plain_text:
Homebuilder Michael Zimmermann's work has included custom residential construction in Spring Lake, New Jersey. A house he built there in 2018 combined an open floor plan and large windows with a finished basement. The project also included a saltwater swimming pool and a two-car garage.

For security installations, Zimmermann developed a continuing relationship with Advantage Fire & Security. Over five years, the firm installed alarm systems throughout the homes he built and worked directly with his customers. He valued correct installation from the outset and also referred other clients to the contractor, receiving favourable feedback about its work.
